objective: Find and independently confirm at least one better strategy; preserve all failed candidates and continue research if none qualifies.
control_policy: Same agent/judge model, prompts, decoding, budgets and original tasks/rubric; only tool-knowledge usage rules and metadata adaptation differ. No new agent rounds, task hints or score changes. All strategies reuse exact K0 at Early.

development.scope: Already exposed course tasks. Development results select/refine candidate; never presented as protected test evidence.

confirmation.scope: Fresh prospective executions on known tasks, not unseen-task generalization; candidate and all knowledge frozen before starting. All cells terminal, 540 valid rating slots required.

adaptation_freeze: Generate each task/stage/method knowledge once, before executions, and reuse across repeats. Account update costs once per unique artifact. This measures performance of frozen harnesses, not updater-generation variance.

promotion_gate.primary: Mean PE over the post-change stages of the fixed three-task set
promotion_gate.completed_execution_count: must not be lower than champion
promotion_gate.repeat_consistency: PE improvement on at least 2 of 3 repeat blocks
promotion_gate.randomization_test: one-sided paired sign-flip test on the 18 post-change task/stage/repeat differences; report conditional-on-task-set inference only
promotion_gate.sequential_alpha: round k uses 0.05 / 2**k; unsuccessful confirmation rounds retained, subsequent candidates require new frozen versions and fresh runs
promotion_gate.baseline_comparison: Always report No Update and Full Rewrite; promotion means improvement over current Selective Patch, not universal superiority over every method/metric

input_boundary: Updater sees metadata plus explicitly frozen tool-probe observations only; no task question, expected answer, current-run trace, judge rationale or score.
history: Old A/B/v1.3 evidence immutable. No low-score reruns or selective missing-cell replacement.
feedback_scope: 12 independent generic MCP probes collected before search; no course question, answer, judgement or scored trace. Exact raw observations plus hash retained.
schema_repair: At most one additional note response to correct invalid JSON/allowed IDs/rule bounds. Every response, request and cost retained; no task execution or judge inputs. Same fixed updater model.
metric_rationale: Course question: recover changed-task TF and retain unchanged-task TF. Main report contains TF/PE/ECS plus recovery, retention and update cost. Search objective: higher post-change PE constrained by TF/ECS/completion/per-task regression gates because exposed subset TF is near ceiling; this is an efficiency-improvement claim, not automatically a TF-recovery claim. Thresholds are our prospective decisions, not course/paper mandates.

hypotheses.sufficiency_notes: ACE-inspired deterministic delta plus a short completion/reuse policy, only on changed/new tools. No extra model call. Optional capabilities do not create new requirements; keep safety checks; never alter data merely to silence diagnostics.
hypotheses.workflow_notes: A-MEM/Reflexion-inspired semantic selection within affected servers, with explicit dependency or overlapping-capability basis and frozen generic probes. Prioritize capability choice, reuse and stopping conditions rather than repeating schemas. Do not mandate optional tool chains.

design_provenance: Designed after all 24 v1.1 development executions: no candidate improved PE. Human inspected development traces and judge rationales, including duplicated validation/evaluation and project over-expansion. No task text, answer, judge score/rationale or scored trace is supplied to the updater; only metadata and the same frozen 12 generic probes. This is development tuning on exposed tasks, not unseen-task evaluation.
workflow_feedback_scope: Current-stage probes for tools in affected servers; this includes supplied successes for possible dependency alternatives. Other stages/servers excluded.
